title: 工具使用：模型請求，程式執行

bullets.text: 模型自己不執行任何東西，它只發出結構化的請求。
bullets.quote: The model never runs anything on its own.

bullets.text: 工具由應用程式（或 Anthropic 的伺服器）執行，結果再回到對話中。
bullets.quote: It emits a structured request, your code (or Anthropic’s servers) runs the operation, and the result flows back into the conversation.

bullets.text: Claude 決定何時、如何呼叫工具；你的程式只看得到工具定義與回傳結果。
bullets.quote: Claude never receives your implementation; it only receives the schema you provided and the result you returned.
